title: [WIP] Address critical gaps in test coverage and performance
body:
- [x] **P0: Internationalization** - Integrate @object-ui/i18n into @object-ui/react for built-in i18n support
  - [x] Add @object-ui/i18n as workspace dependency to @object-ui/react
  - [x] Re-export full i18n API (I18nProvider, useObjectTranslation, createI18n, formatters, types) from @object-ui/react
  - [x] Users can now `import { I18nProvider, useObjectTranslation } from '@object-ui/react'`
- [x] **P0: Performance** - Bundle size optimizations via tree-shaking
  - [x] Add `sideEffects: false` to @object-ui/types, @object-ui/core, @object-ui/i18n, @object-ui/layout
  - [x] Enables bundlers to tree-shake unused exports, reducing bundle size
- [x] **P0: Test Coverage** - Comprehensive tests added across packages
  - [x] useExpression + useCondition hooks (0% → tested)
  - [x] useDiscovery hook (0% → tested)
  - [x] useActionRunner hook (42% → tested)
  - [x] ActionContext (ActionProvider, useAction, useHasActionProvider) (54% → tested)
  - [x] i18n provider (I18nProvider, useObjectTranslation, useI18nContext) (new tests)
  - [x] LazyPluginLoader (preloadPlugin, errorFallback, retry) (54% → tested)
  - [x] Timeline renderer (vertical, horizontal, gantt) (15% → tested)
  - [x] SortUI component (36% → tested)
  - [x] FilterUI component (39% → tested)
  - [x] VirtualGrid component (5% → tested)
  - [x] Raised coverage thresholds: lines 61→66, functions 43→55, branches 40→50, statements 60→65
